about: A small self-hosted bookmarking service that needs no database.

prs.title: Links saved at the turn of the year show in the right week
prs.broken: Links saved in the last days of December could land on the weekly page from a year earlier, and the real first week of the new year pointed back to an empty page.
prs.changed: The weekly page now uses the same year as the week number, so the two always agree.
prs.matters: Every link shows up on the weekly page for the week it was saved.
